sn8.5:1.4: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ || || 4.
sn8.5:2.1: Catūhi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti na dubbhāsitā || anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnaṃ ||
sn8.5:2.3: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu subhāsitaṃ yeva bhāsati no dubbhāsitam || dhammaṃ yeva bhāsati no adhammaṃ || piyaṃ yeva bhāsati no appiyam || saccaṃ yeva bhāsati no alikaṃ ||
sn8.5:2.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave catūhi aṅgehi samannāgatā vācā subhāsitā hoti no dubbhāsitā anavajjā ca ananuvajjā ca viññūnan ti || || 6.
sn8.5:2.6: idam vatvāna Sugato athāparam etad avoca satthā || ||
sn8.5:3.4: saccaṃ bhaṇe nālikam tam catutthan ti || || 7.
sn8.5:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā Vaṅgīso uṭṭhāyāsanā ekaṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā ten-añjaliṃ paṇāmetvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn8.5:4.2: Paṭibhāti maṃ Bhagavā paṭibhāti maṃ Sugatā ti || || 8.
sn8.5:4.3: Paṭibhātu taṃ Vaṅgīsā ti Bhagavā avoca || || 9.
sn8.5:4.4: Atha kho āyasmā Vaṅgīso Bhagavantam sammukhā sarūpāhi gāthāhi abhitthavi || ||
